text: {"label": "Conditional Discrimination Training Procedures","definition": "Research on establishing simple and conditional discriminations, examining training sequences, prompting, fading, errorless learning, stimulus disparity, and discriminability and bias as they affect acquisition and the emergence of untrained discriminations.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Focuses on procedures and variables for teaching discriminations, unlike equivalence-class formation theory, conditioned reinforcement and suppression, or general stimulus control boundaries and outcome value."}
